units.chapter_en: Seeking a school post (with the tuition fee)
units.title: 求馆·世为西席，如逢父母必明经（旧注：占书馆以世爻为西席之位；世临父其先生必明经，世在乾坤离三宫亦然；临官带贵或本宫官伏世下多是秀才）

rule.yi: 占书馆（去当塾师），以世爻代表西席，也就是教书的先生。世爻临父母，这位先生一定是通晓经书的人；世在乾、坤、离三宫也是这样；世临官爻又带贵人，或者本宫的官鬼伏在世爻下面，多半是秀才。
rule.en: In divining a school post, the Self stands for the tutor's seat, that is, the teacher. If the Self rests on Resource, the teacher is surely versed in the classics, and so too if the Self is in the Qian, Kun or Li palace; if it rests on Pressure with a noble, or the home palace's Pressure lies hidden under the Self, he is mostly a licentiate.

zh: 学得明师，可继程风于满座；
师非良馆，难期贾粟之盈仓。
故欲笔耕，先须蓍筮。
yi: 跟明师学习，可以承继程氏讲学的风范，座无虚席；
老师若没有好的书馆，就难指望束修像商人囤粮那样装满仓库；
所以想靠笔耕谋生，先要用蓍草占筮。
en: Learning under a bright teacher, one can carry on the manner of the Cheng school, with every seat filled;
if the teacher has no good school, it is hard to hope for stored grain filling the granary like a merchant's;
so whoever wishes to earn his living by the pen should first consult the yarrow stalks.

zh: 世为西席，如逢父母必明经；
yi: 世爻是西席，如果遇到父母，一定通晓经书；
en: The Self is the tutor's seat, and if it meets Resource he is surely versed in the classics;

zh: 凡占书馆，以世爻为西席之位。
如临父，其先生必是明经之人。
世在乾坤离三宫，亦然。
临官带贵，或本宫官伏世下，多是秀才。
yi: 凡是占书馆，以世爻作为西席的位置。
如果临父爻，那位先生必定是通晓经书的人。
世在乾、坤、离三宫，也是这样。
临官爻又带贵人，或者本宫的官鬼伏在世爻下面，多半是秀才。
en: In divining a school, the Self is taken as the place of the tutor.
If it rests on Resource, the teacher is surely a man versed in the classics.
If the Self is in the Qian, Kun or Li palace, it is the same.
If it rests on Pressure with a noble, or the home palace's Pressure lies hidden under the Self, he is mostly a licentiate.

zh: 凡占书馆，以世爻为西席之位，如临父母，自必明经，在离、乾、坤三宫亦然；
临官带鬼或本宫官伏世下，多是秀长。
yi: 凡占书馆，以世爻作为西席的位置，如果临父母，自然通晓经书，在离、乾、坤三宫也是这样；
临官爻带官鬼，或者本宫的官鬼伏在世爻下面，多半是秀才。
en: In divining a school, the Self is taken as the place of the tutor, and if it rests on Resource he is naturally versed in the classics, and it is the same in the Li, Qian or Kun palace;
if it rests on Pressure and carries Pressure, or the home palace's Pressure lies hidden under the Self, he is mostly a licentiate.

note.yi: 「西席」是塾师的座位（古时宾客坐西，主人坐东，所以请来教书的先生叫「西席」），这一章因此用「世」代表先生，「应」代表聘请他的「东家」。「明经」本是汉代的科目，这里指通晓经书的人；「秀才」是生员。章首三句是引语，不是判断：「程风」指程颢、程颐两兄弟讲学的风气，「贾粟之盈仓」是说像商人囤积粮食那样装满仓库，「笔耕」是靠教书、写文章谋生。卜筮正宗写「秀长」，「长」是「才」的误写。
note.en: 'The tutor's seat' is the seat of the schoolmaster (in old etiquette the guest sat in the west and the host in the east, so the teacher invited to teach was called 'the west seat'), and this chapter therefore takes the Self for the teacher and the Other for the 'host family' that engages him. 'Versed in the classics' was originally a Han examination subject and here means a man who has mastered the classics; a 'licentiate' is a district-school student. The first three sentences of the chapter are a preface and not a judgement: 'the Cheng school' is the manner of teaching of the brothers Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi, 'stored grain filling the granary like a merchant's' means a granary filled as a merchant fills his, and 'earning one's living by the pen' is making a living by teaching and writing. The Bushi Zhengzong writes 'licentiate' with a misprinted second character.

units.chapter_en: Seeking a school post (with the tuition fee)
units.title: 求馆·应乃东家，若遇官爻须作吏（旧注：应爻为东家主人；临官是官吏户役人家，加白虎有病人，加玄武与盗贼往来；临父母加勾陈种田、朱雀读书、白虎宰杀、螣蛇工艺；临子属金僧道作主；临财无官妇人作主、有官富贵、财化财财化子做买卖；临兄弟平常人家、加朱雀赌博）

rule.yi: 占馆，应爻代表聘请先生的东家，看应爻临什么来断这家人：临官爻，是官吏、户役人家（加白虎有病人，加玄武与盗贼往来）；临父母，加勾陈是种田人家，加朱雀是读书人家，加白虎是宰杀人家，加螣蛇是工艺人家；临子孙属金，是僧道作主；临财爻在阴宫阴爻又没有官鬼的，是妇人作主，有官鬼就是富贵人家，财化财、财化子是做买卖的人家，被月建日辰动爻制伏的是奴仆作主；临兄弟，是平常人家，加朱雀是赌博人家。
rule.en: In divining a school post, the Other stands for the host family that engages the teacher, and one judges the household from what the Other rests on: on Pressure, an official's or clerk's household (with the White Tiger, a sick person; with the Dark Tortoise, dealings with thieves); on Resource, a farming household with Hook Earth, a scholars' household with the Vermilion Bird, a slaughterers' household with the White Tiger, a craftsmen's household with the Coiling Snake; on Output belonging to Metal, a monk or Daoist is the master; on Wealth in a yin palace and on a yin line with no Pressure, a woman is the master, with Pressure a rich and noble household, with Wealth turning into Wealth or Output a trading household, and if subdued by the Month, the Day or a moving line, a servant is the master; on Peer, an ordinary household, with the Vermilion Bird a gambling household.

zh: 应乃东家，若遇官爻须作吏。
yi: 应爻是东家，如果遇到官爻，是官吏人家。
en: The Other is the host family, and if it meets Pressure, it is an official's household.

zh: 应爻为占馆东家主人。
若临官，必是官吏户役人家；
加白虎，则是病人；
在三爻现，病在床；
休囚受制，则有孝服在身；
加玄武，必与盗贼往来。
应临父母加勾陈，种田人家；
加朱雀，读书人家；
加白虎，宰杀人家；
加螣蛇，工艺人家。
应临子属金，僧道作主；
加朱雀玄武，是打猎人家；
不然，则后生辈也。
应临财爻，更在阴宫，又临阴爻，而卦无官鬼者，必是妇人作主；
有官则是富贵人家。
财化财，财化子，做买卖人家。
若被月建日辰动爻制伏，乃是奴仆为主。
应临兄弟，平常人家；
加朱雀，赌博人家；
系本宫，弟兄姊妹家；
系他宫，朋友邻里家。
若论住宅，依家宅章断。
yi: 应爻是占馆的东家主人。
如果临官爻，必定是官吏、户役人家；
加白虎，就是有病人；
在三爻出现，病人卧床；
休囚受制，就有孝服在身；
加玄武，必定与盗贼往来。
应爻临父母加勾陈，是种田人家；
加朱雀，是读书人家；
加白虎，是宰杀人家；
加螣蛇，是工艺人家。
应爻临子孙属金，是僧道作主；
加朱雀、玄武，是打猎人家；
不然，就是年轻一辈。
应爻临财爻，又在阴宫、临阴爻，而卦里没有官鬼的，必是妇人作主；
有官鬼，就是富贵人家。
财化财、财化子孙，是做买卖的人家。
如果被月建、日辰、动爻制伏，就是奴仆作主。
应爻临兄弟，是平常人家；
加朱雀，是赌博人家；
系本宫的，是兄弟姊妹家；
系他宫的，是朋友邻里家。
如果要论住宅，依家宅章来断。
en: The Other is the master of the household that engages the tutor.
If it rests on Pressure, it is surely the household of an official, a clerk or a serving man;
with the White Tiger added, there is a sick person;
if it appears on the third line, the sick person is bedridden;
if resting, trapped or controlled, someone is in mourning dress;
with the Dark Tortoise added, they surely keep company with thieves.
If the Other rests on Resource with Hook Earth added, it is a farming household;
with the Vermilion Bird, a family of scholars;
with the White Tiger, a family of slaughterers;
with the Coiling Snake, a family of craftsmen.
If the Other rests on Output belonging to Metal, a monk or Daoist is the master;
with the Vermilion Bird and the Dark Tortoise, a hunting family;
otherwise it is the younger generation.
If the Other rests on Wealth, in a yin palace and on a yin line, and there is no Pressure in the hexagram, a woman is surely the master;
if there is Pressure, it is a rich and noble household.
Wealth turning into Wealth or into Output is a trading household.
If it is subdued by the Month, the Day or a moving line, a servant is the master.
If the Other rests on Peer, it is an ordinary household;
with the Vermilion Bird, a gambling family;
if it belongs to the home palace, the home of brothers and sisters;
if it belongs to another palace, the home of friends and neighbours.
If the dwelling is to be discussed, judge by the chapter on the house.

zh: 应爻为占馆本家主人，若临官，必是官吏役人家，加白虎则是病人。
就临父母勾陈，种田人家；
加朱雀，若是读书人家；
加白虎，宰杀人家；
加螣蛇，工艺人家。
应临子属金，僧道作主；
应临财在阴宫阴爻而卦无官鬼者，必是妇人作主；
若应爻临官又举贵人，则是富贵人家；
财化财、财化子，做买卖人家。
yi: 应爻是占馆的本家主人，如果临官爻，必定是官吏、役人家，加白虎就是有病人。
就是临父母加勾陈，是种田人家；
加朱雀，如果是读书人家；
加白虎，是宰杀人家；
加螣蛇，是工艺人家。
应爻临子孙属金，是僧道作主；
应爻临财在阴宫阴爻而卦里没有官鬼的，必是妇人作主；
如果应爻临官又见贵人，就是富贵人家；
财化财、财化子孙，是做买卖的人家。
en: The Other is the master of the household in divining a school post; if it rests on Pressure, it is surely the household of an official or a serving man, and with the White Tiger there is a sick person.
if it rests on Resource with Hook Earth, a farming household;
with the Vermilion Bird, perhaps a family of scholars;
with the White Tiger, a family of slaughterers;
with the Coiling Snake, a family of craftsmen.
if the Other rests on Output belonging to Metal, a monk or Daoist is the master;
if the Other rests on Wealth in a yin palace and on a yin line and there is no Pressure in the hexagram, a woman is surely the master;
if the Other rests on Pressure and a noble also appears, it is a rich and noble household;
Wealth turning into Wealth or into Output is a trading household.

note.yi: 这一联是用「应爻临什么」来断东家是什么人家：六亲定行当（官是官吏、父是耕读、子孙属金是僧道、财是买卖或妇人、兄弟是平常人），六神再细分（勾陈种田、朱雀读书、白虎宰杀、螣蛇工艺、玄武盗贼或打猎）。「户役」是承担差役的户；「孝服在身」是家里有丧事。旧注比王洪绪多出的部分：玄武的盗贼、子孙加朱雀玄武的打猎、财有官鬼是富贵人家以及被制伏是奴仆作主、兄弟一类（平常人家、赌博、兄弟姊妹家、朋友邻里家）。王洪绪把旧注的「财爻有官是富贵人家」改成「应临官又举贵人，是富贵人家」，条件不同：旧注是应临财、卦里有官鬼，王洪绪是应临官爻又有贵人。
note.en: This couplet judges what kind of household the host is by 'what the Other rests on': the six relations fix the trade (Pressure an official or clerk, Resource farming and scholarship, Output belonging to Metal a monk or Daoist, Wealth trade or a woman, Peer an ordinary person) and the six spirits subdivide it (Hook Earth farming, the Vermilion Bird scholarship, the White Tiger slaughter, the Coiling Snake crafts, the Dark Tortoise thieves or hunting). 'A household with corvée duty' is a household bearing service duties; 'in mourning dress' means there is a death in the family. What the old commentary has beyond Wang Hongxu: the Dark Tortoise and thieves, Output with the Vermilion Bird and the Dark Tortoise as hunters, Wealth with Pressure as a rich and noble household, being subdued as a servant being the master, and the Peer sort (ordinary household, gambling, the home of brothers and sisters, the home of friends and neighbours). Wang Hongxu changes the old commentary's 'Wealth with Pressure is a rich and noble household' into 'the Other rests on Pressure and a noble also appears is a rich and noble household', with a different condition: in the old commentary the Other rests on Wealth and there is Pressure in the hexagram, and in Wang Hongxu the Other rests on Pressure and there is a noble.

units.chapter_en: Seeking a school post (with the tuition fee)
units.title: 求馆·临官兮少壮、休囚则贫乏之家；墓库兮高年、旺相则富豪之主（旧注：应临临官帝旺主人强壮、临墓库是高年；五行无气家贫乏、旺相家富厚、重加财福巨富；德性以五类六神参断）

rule.yi: 应爻临临官、帝旺，主人必定年壮强盛，临墓库必是高龄；应爻的五行没有气，他家贫乏，旺相就富厚，再加上财爻、子孙，必然是巨富；他的品德性情，要按五类和六神一起参断。
rule.en: If the Other rests on the Official-Post or Peak stage, the master is surely in his prime and strong, and if on a tomb he is surely advanced in years; if the element of the Other has no breath, his family is poor, if thriving, rich, and with Wealth and Output added he is surely enormously rich; his character is to be judged by the five relations and the six spirits together.

zh: 临官兮少壮，休囚则贫乏之家；
墓库兮高年，旺相则富豪之主。
yi: 临官位的，主人年少壮盛，休囚就是贫乏的人家；
临墓库的，主人高龄，旺相就是富豪的主人。
en: On the Official-Post stage the master is young and in his prime, and if resting or trapped it is a poor household;
on a tomb he is of great age, and if thriving he is a wealthy master.

zh: 应爻在临官帝旺爻，主人必然强壮。
如临墓库，必是高年。
五行无气，其家贫乏；
五行旺相，其家富厚；
重加财福，必然巨富。
德性以五类六神参断。
yi: 应爻在临官、帝旺爻上，主人必然强壮。
如果临墓库，必是高龄。
五行没有气，他家贫乏；
五行旺相，他家富厚；
再加财爻、子孙，必然是巨富。
品德性情，要按五类和六神一起参断。
en: If the Other is on a line at the Official-Post or Peak stage, the master is surely strong and in his prime.
If it rests on a tomb, he is surely advanced in years.
If its element has no breath, his family is poor;
if its element is thriving, his family is rich;
with Wealth and Output added, he is surely enormously rich.
His character is to be judged by the five relations and the six spirits together.

zh: 应爻临旺爻，主人必然强壮，如临墓库，必是老年。
临财福必然富贵。
若论其德性，当以五类六神参断。
yi: 应爻临旺爻，主人必然强壮，如果临墓库，必是老年。
临财、子孙，必然富贵。
如果要论他的品德性情，应当按五类、六神参断。
en: If the Other rests on a thriving line, the master is surely strong, and if it rests on a tomb, he is surely old.
With Wealth and Output, he is surely rich and noble.
If his character is to be discussed, it should be judged by the five relations and the six spirits.

note.yi: 「临官」「帝旺」是十二长生里的两个阶段（临官是壮年成人，帝旺是最盛），「墓库」是入墓的阶段（衰老）。这一联用十二长生的阶段看东家的年龄，用五行旺衰看家境。王洪绪写「临财福必然富贵」，旧注是「重加财福，必然巨富」：旧注要财福重叠才说巨富，王洪绪只要临财福就说富贵，程度略有不同。
note.en: 'Official-Post' and 'Peak' are two stages of the twelve life stages (Official-Post is a man grown and in his prime, Peak is the fullest), and 'tomb' is the stage of entering the tomb (old age). This couplet reads the master's age from the life stage and the circumstances of the family from the element's strength. Wang Hongxu writes 'with Wealth and Output he is surely rich and noble' while the old commentary says 'with Wealth and Output piled on, he is surely enormously rich': the old commentary needs Wealth and Output doubled before it says enormously rich, and Wang Hongxu says rich and noble at once for being on Wealth and Output, a slightly different degree.

units.chapter_en: Seeking a school post (with the tuition fee)
units.title: 求馆·值土火空无父母，逢金水绝少儿孙（旧注：卦中六亲即人六亲，两人系于一卦以相生之理定：应属土则火是父母、属金则水是子孙；火旺空冲空动空父母不全、衰空无父母；带官鬼贵、兄弟好赌、财贸易、子孙慈善；在应宫者为彼六亲、在世宫者为我六亲）

rule.yi: 一个卦里系着两个人时，两人的六亲要用相生的道理来定：占馆以应为东家，应爻属土，火生土，不论卦里有没有火、也不论是哪一类六亲，都当作他的父母；应爻属金，金生水，水就当作他的子孙。火爻旺而空、冲空、动空，父母不全，衰而空就没有父母；火化火有两重父母；带官鬼旺相是贵，衰是病，带兄弟是好赌、无廉耻，带财是做买卖，带子孙是慈善。不能把六爻总起来看，在应宫的爻是对方的六亲，在世宫的爻是我的六亲。
rule.en: When two persons are tied to one hexagram, their relations are fixed by the principle of generation: in divining a school post the Other is the host, and if the Other belongs to Earth, Fire generates Earth, and whether or not there is Fire in the hexagram and whatever relation it is, it is taken as his parents; if the Other belongs to Metal, Metal generates Water, and Water is taken as his children. If the Fire line is thriving but Void, clashed Void or moved Void, his parents are not both alive, and if weak and Void he has no parents; Fire turning into Fire means two sets of parents; carrying Pressure that is thriving means nobility, weak, illness; carrying Peer means gambling and shamelessness; carrying Wealth means trade; carrying Output means kindness. The six lines are not to be looked at all together: lines in the Other's palace are the other's relations, and lines in the Self's palace are all my relations.

zh: 值土火空，无父母；
逢金水绝，少儿孙。
yi: 应是土而火空，没有父母；
应是金而水绝，缺少儿孙。
en: With Earth and Fire Void, there are no parents;
with Metal and Water in extinction, there are few sons and grandsons.

zh: 卦中六亲，即人六亲。
然有两人系于一卦者，则彼此六亲宜不同矣。
又当何以定之？
不过生之理而已。
且如占馆，以应为东家。
应爻属土，火能生土，不拘卦中有无，亦不拘是财官父子，皆作父母断，生我者故也。
应爻属金，金能生水，不拘卦中有无，亦不拘财官父兄，皆作子孙断，我生故也。
如火爻旺空、冲空、动空，主父母不全，衰空必无父母。
火化火，两重父母。
带官鬼旺，以贵断，衰以病言。
带兄弟，其父好赌博，无廉耻，欠学问。
带财爻，其父不富厚，则业贸易。
带子孙，其父则甚慈善，慷慨有为。
余皆仿此。
但不可以六爻总看，当以在应宫者为彼六亲，在世宫者皆我六亲也。
一宫三爻，只余二爻，此宫不现者，不可遂断为有无，惟空亡乃是真无也。
其贵贱寿夭，性情容貌，依常例推之。
他如兄弟妻妾子息，亦仿此推之。
yi: 卦中的六亲，就是人的六亲。
但是有两个人系在一个卦上的，他们的六亲就应该不同了。
又应该用什么来定呢？
不过是相生的道理而已。
就拿占馆来说，以应爻为东家。
应爻属土，火能生土，不论卦中有没有火，也不论它是财、官、父、子哪一类，都当作父母来断，因为是生我的。
应爻属金，金能生水，不论卦中有没有水，也不论它是财、官、父、兄哪一类，都当作子孙来断，因为是我所生的。
如果火爻旺相而空、冲空、动空，主父母不全，衰弱而空必定没有父母。
火化出火，是有两重父母。
带官鬼旺相，按贵人来断，衰弱就说有病。
带兄弟，他的父亲好赌博，没有廉耻，欠缺学问。
带财爻，他的父亲不富厚，就是做买卖。
带子孙，他的父亲就很慈善，慷慨有为。
其余的都照这样推。
但是不能把六爻总起来看，应当以在应宫里的爻作为对方的六亲，在世宫里的爻都是我的六亲。
一宫三爻，只剩两爻，这一宫不出现的，不能就断为有无，只有空亡才是真正没有。
他的贵贱、寿夭、性情、容貌，依照平常的办法来推。
其他如兄弟、妻妾、子女，也照这样推。
en: The six relations in the hexagram are a person's six relations.
But when two persons are tied to one hexagram, their relations must differ.
By what, then, are they to be fixed?
It is nothing more than the principle of generation.
Take divining a school post: the Other is the master of the household.

If the Other belongs to Earth, then since Fire generates Earth, whether or not Fire is in the hexagram, and whatever relation it is, Wealth, Pressure, Resource or Output, it is judged as his parents, because it is what generates him.

If the Other belongs to Metal, then since Metal generates Water, whether or not Water is in the hexagram, and whatever relation it is, Wealth, Pressure, Resource or Peer, it is judged as his children, because it is what he generates.
If a Fire line is thriving but Void, clashed Void or moved Void, his parents are not both alive, and if weak and Void he surely has no parents.
Fire turning into Fire means two sets of parents.
If it carries Pressure that is thriving, judge by nobility, and if weak, say there is illness.
If it carries Peer, his father is fond of gambling, shameless and lacking in learning.
If it carries Wealth, his father is not rich, or is in trade.
If it carries Output, his father is very kind-hearted, generous and capable.
The rest are inferred in the same way.
But the six lines are not to be looked at all together: the lines in the Other's palace are taken as the other's relations, and the lines in the Self's palace are all my relations.
A palace has three lines, with only two left over, and when one of this palace does not appear, one cannot at once judge it present or absent; only Void is truly absent.
His nobility or lowliness, long or short life, temperament and looks are inferred by the usual methods.
Others such as brothers, wives and concubines, and children are likewise inferred in this way.

zh: 卦得坤属土，如火爻旺空、动空、冲空，主父母不全，衰空必无父母。
若卦得乾兑属金，如无水爻，水又绝于飞爻或绝于日辰，则主无子孙。
余皆仿此。
yi: 卦得坤属土，如果火爻旺相而空、动空、冲空，主父母不全，衰弱而空必定没有父母。
如果卦得乾、兑属金，如果没有水爻，水又绝在飞爻或者绝在日辰，就主没有子孙。
其余都照这样推。
en: If the hexagram obtained is Kun, belonging to Earth, and a Fire line is thriving but Void, moved Void or clashed Void, his parents are not both alive, and if weak and Void he surely has no parents.
If the hexagram obtained is Qian or Dui, belonging to Metal, and there is no Water line, or Water is in extinction at the flying line or at the Day, he has no children.
The rest are inferred in the same way.

dispute.yi: 两家用什么五行来定「父母」「子孙」，说法不一样：旧注看应爻的五行（应属土，火是他的父母；应属金，水是他的子孙），不管卦里有没有这个爻，也不论它是哪一类六亲；王洪绪看的是卦的宫（卦得坤宫属土，看火爻；卦得乾、兑宫属金，看水爻），而且要「水又绝于飞爻或绝于日辰」才说无子孙。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The two commentators differ on which element fixes the 'parents' and the 'children': the old commentary looks at the element of the Other (if the Other belongs to Earth, Fire is his parents, and if it belongs to Metal, Water is his children), whether or not that line is in the hexagram and whatever relation it is; Wang Hongxu looks at the palace of the hexagram (a hexagram of the Kun palace, belonging to Earth, looks at the Fire line, and one of the Qian or Dui palace, belonging to Metal, looks at the Water line), and says there are no children only if Water is also 'in extinction at the flying line or at the Day'. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 这一联讲的是「人」的六亲和「卦」的六亲不是一回事：卦里的父母、子孙等是对「我」说的；要看对方（东家）的父母子孙，得按对方自己的五行，从生的关系重新定。旧注的例子：应属土，火生土，所以火就是东家的父母；应属金，金生水，所以水是东家的子孙。「飞爻」是卦的爻（显现的爻），「飞神」「伏神」见术语表。这条是整本书里少见的、把「两个人系在一个卦上」讲清楚的地方。
note.en: This couplet says that the relations of the 'person' are not the same as the relations of the 'hexagram': Resource, Output and the others in the hexagram are said relative to 'me'; to see the host's parents and children one must refix them from the host's own element by the relation of generation. The old commentary's example: if the Other belongs to Earth, Fire generates Earth, so Fire is the host's parents; if the Other belongs to Metal, Metal generates Water, so Water is the host's children. 'The flying line' is the line of the hexagram (the visible line); see the glossary for 'flying line' and 'hidden line'. This is one of the few places in the book that makes clear how two persons can be tied to one hexagram.

units.chapter_en: Seeking a school post (with the tuition fee)
units.title: 求馆·不拱不和，决定主宾不协；相生相合，必然情意相投（旧注：世应刑冲克害日后宾主不合，兄官发动大凶；生合比和情意相投；生而化克始和终不和、冲而化合始疏后密；世与子宜生合则师弟恩义兼尽，冲克则多不睦）

rule.yi: 世应两爻刑冲克害，日后宾主一定不合，再加上兄弟、官鬼发动，是大凶的兆头；世应生合比和，情意必定相投；生而化出克，开始和睦、最后不和；冲而化出合，开始疏远、后来亲密；世爻和子孙也适宜生合，师生之间就恩义兼尽，见到冲克也多不睦。
rule.en: If the Self and the Other punish, clash, control or harm each other, the guest and host will surely be at odds in time, and if Peer and Pressure also move it is a greatly ominous sign; if the Self and the Other generate, combine or are in harmony, their feelings will surely be congenial; generation turning into control is harmonious at the start and not at the end; a clash turning into a combination is distant at first and close afterwards; it is also fitting that the Self and Output generate or combine, and then the teacher and his pupils fulfil both kindness and duty, while with a clash or control they are mostly not on good terms.

zh: 不拱不和，决定主宾不协；
相生相合，必然情意相投。
yi: 不相拱合、不相和睦，一定是主人和宾客不协调；
相生相合，情意必定相投。
en: If they neither flank nor harmonise with each other, host and guest are surely not in accord;
if they generate and combine with each other, their feelings will surely be congenial.

zh: 世应二爻刑冲克害，异日宾主不合。
加以兄官发动，大凶之兆。
若得生合比和，情意必然相投。
生而化克，始和终不和；
冲而化合，始疏而后密。
世与子亦宜生合，则师弟间恩义兼尽。
若见冲克，亦多不睦也。
yi: 世、应两爻刑冲克害，日后宾主不合。
再加上兄弟、官鬼发动，是大凶的兆头。
如果得到生合比和，情意必定相投。
生而化克，开始和睦、最后不和；
冲而化合，开始疏远、后来亲密。
世爻和子孙也适宜生合，那么师生之间恩义兼尽。
如果见到冲克，也多半不和睦。
en: If the Self and the Other punish, clash, control or harm each other, the guest and host will in time be at odds.
If Peer and Pressure also move, it is a greatly ominous sign.
If they generate, combine or are in harmony, their feelings will surely be congenial.
Generation turning into control: harmonious at the start, not at the end;
a clash turning into a combination: distant at first and close afterwards.
It is also fitting that the Self and Output generate or combine, and then the teacher and his pupils fulfil both kindness and duty.
If clash or control is seen, they are likewise mostly not on good terms.

zh: 世应刑冲克害，异日宾主不和；
若得生合比和，情意相投；
生而化克，始和终不睦；
冲而化合，始疏后密。
应与子孙生合，师徒则多恩义，若见冲克多不睦也。
yi: 世应刑冲克害，日后宾主不和；
如果得到生合比和，情意相投；
生而化克，开始和睦、最后不和睦；
冲而化合，开始疏远、后来亲密。
应爻和子孙生合，师生之间就多恩义，如果见到冲克，多半不和睦。
en: If the Self and the Other punish, clash, control or harm each other, the guest and host will in time be at odds;
if they generate, combine or are in harmony, their feelings are congenial;
generation turning into control is harmonious at the start and not at the end;
a clash turning into a combination is distant at first and close afterwards.
If the Other and Output generate or combine, the teacher and his pupils have much kindness and duty between them, and if clash or control is seen they are mostly not on good terms.

dispute.yi: 师生的关系看哪一爻和子孙的关系，两家说法不一样：旧注说「世与子亦宜生合」（世爻是先生，子孙是学生，先生和学生要合）；王洪绪却写「应与子孙生合」（应爻和子孙）。「应」是东家，「世」是先生，按这一章的体例师生关系应是世和子孙，王洪绪的「应」像是误写，但书里没有说明。
dispute.en: The two commentators differ over which line is paired with Output for the relation of teacher and pupils: the old commentary says 'it is also fitting that the Self and Output generate or combine' (the Self is the teacher and Output the pupils, so teacher and pupils should be in accord), while Wang Hongxu writes 'the Other and Output generate or combine' (the Other and Output). The Other is the host and the Self is the teacher, and by the plan of this chapter the relation of teacher and pupils should be the Self and Output, so Wang Hongxu's 'the Other' looks like a misprint, but the book does not say.

note.yi: 「拱」是两爻夹住中间一爻（这里泛指相合相助）；「宾主」是先生（宾）和东家（主）。这一联讲先生（世）和东家（应）是否合得来，「生而化克、冲而化合」是说一开始的关系会在变爻上反过来，这是通用的判据，在别的章节里也常见。
note.en: 'Flank' is two lines holding a middle line between them (here used loosely for combining and helping each other); 'guest and host' are the teacher (guest) and the host family (host). This couplet is about whether the teacher (the Self) and the host (the Other) get on, and 'generation turning into control, a clash turning into a combination' says the relation at the start is reversed in the changed line, a general criterion that is also often met in other chapters.

units.chapter_en: Seeking a school post (with the tuition fee)
units.title: 求馆·财作束修，不宜化弟（旧注：以妻财为束修，旺相多、休囚少；以生成数推斤两，生旺倍、绝死半，阳宫生数、阴宫成数；兄弟发动或财化兄束修不尽入己；财无气得生扶则束修虽少节礼周备）

rule.yi: 占馆以妻财为束修（学费）。财旺相就多，休囚就少；要知道有多少，用生成数来推，生旺加倍，绝死减半，在阳宫用生数，在阴宫用成数；只怕兄弟发动或者财化出兄弟，束修不能都归自己，必有人抽成分用，不然就有名无实；财爻无气而遇月建日辰动爻生扶的，束修虽然不多，四季节礼反而周全。
rule.en: In divining a school post, Wealth is the tuition fee. If thriving it is much, and if resting or trapped, little; to know how much, infer by the generating and completing numbers, doubled if in birth or thriving and halved if in extinction or death, using the generating number in a yang palace and the completing number in a yin palace; what is feared is Peer moving or Wealth turning into Peer, and then the fee does not all go to oneself, someone takes a share, or it is in name only; if Wealth has no breath but is generated or supported by the Month, the Day or a moving line, the fee, though not large, is made up for by gifts at the four seasons' festivals.

zh: 财作束修，不宜化弟；
yi: 妻财是束修，不适合化出兄弟；
en: Wealth is the tuition fee, and it is not fitting for it to turn into Peer;

zh: 占馆以妻财为束修。
旺相多，休囚少。
要知斤两，以生成数推之，生旺倍加，绝死减半。
在阳宫以生数断，在阴宫以成数断。
今人但言水一、火二、木三、金四、土五，而不言六七八九十，是举其生数，而遗其成数也。
独怕兄弟发动，或财化兄，主束修不皆入己，必有人抽分费用。
不然，则有名无实，亦不能尽取之也。
财爻无气，而遇月建日辰动爻生扶者，束修虽不多，四季节礼反周备也。
易云：天一地二，天三地四，天五地六，天七地八，天九地十，生也。
yi: 占馆，以妻财为束修。
旺相就多，休囚就少。
要知道有多少斤两，用生成数来推，生旺加倍，绝死减半。
在阳宫用生数断，在阴宫用成数断。
现在的人只说水一、火二、木三、金四、土五，而不说六七八九十，是只举了生数而漏掉了成数。
只怕兄弟发动，或者财化出兄弟，主束修不能都归自己，必有人抽成、分去费用。
不然，就是有名无实，也不能全部拿到。
财爻无气，却遇到月建、日辰、动爻生扶的，束修虽然不多，四季的节礼反而周全。
《易》说：天一地二，天三地四，天五地六，天七地八，天九地十，这是生。
en: In divining a school post, Wealth is the tuition fee.
If thriving it is much, if resting or trapped, little.
To know the weight, infer by the generating and completing numbers: doubled if in birth or thriving, halved if in extinction or death.
In a yang palace judge by the generating number, in a yin palace by the completing number.
People now say only Water one, Fire two, Wood three, Metal four, Earth five, and not six, seven, eight, nine and ten, which cites the generating numbers and omits the completing numbers.
What is feared is Peer moving or Wealth turning into Peer, which means the fee does not all go to oneself and someone takes a share or a cut.
Otherwise it is in name only and cannot be taken in full.
If Wealth has no breath but is generated or supported by the Month, the Day or a moving line, the fee, though not large, is made up for by gifts at the four seasons' festivals.
The Changes say: Heaven one, Earth two, Heaven three, Earth four, Heaven five, Earth six, Heaven seven, Earth eight, Heaven nine, Earth ten: this is generation.

zh: 占馆以财爻为束修，独怕兄弟发动或财爻化兄，主束修有名无实。
财爻无气，而遇日辰动爻生扶拱合者，束修虽则不多，而四季节礼则周备也。
yi: 占馆以财爻为束修，只怕兄弟发动或者财爻化出兄弟，主束修有名无实。
财爻无气，而遇到日辰、动爻生扶拱合的，束修虽然不多，而四季的节礼却周全。
en: In divining a school post Wealth is the tuition fee, and what is feared is Peer moving or Wealth turning into Peer, which means the fee is in name only.
If Wealth has no breath but is generated, supported, flanked or combined by the Day or a moving line, the fee, though not large, is made up for by gifts at the four seasons' festivals.

note.yi: 「束修」本是十条干肉，古时拜师的见面礼，后来指学费、塾师的薪金。「生数、成数」是河图的数：一二三四五是生数（水一、火二、木三、金四、土五），六七八九十是成数（水六、火七、木八、金九、土十）；旧注的意思是，按财爻的五行取数，阳宫用生数、阴宫用成数，旺相再加倍、衰绝减半，来估计束修的多少。这个算法书里没有给例子，也没有说单位。旧注最后一句引《易》的「天一地二……」，原文只写到「生也」，像是没写全，译文按字面。「抽分」是从里面抽取一份。
note.en: 'Tuition fee' was originally ten strips of dried meat, the gift of first meeting a teacher in old times, and later meant tuition and the schoolmaster's pay. 'The generating and completing numbers' are the numbers of the River Diagram: one to five are the generating numbers (Water one, Fire two, Wood three, Metal four, Earth five) and six to ten the completing numbers (Water six, Fire seven, Wood eight, Metal nine, Earth ten); the old commentary means that one takes the number from the element of the Wealth line, the generating number in a yang palace and the completing number in a yin palace, doubled if thriving and halved if in extinction, to estimate the fee, and the book gives no example of this calculation nor the unit. The old commentary's last sentence quotes the Changes, 'Heaven one, Earth two ...', and the original stops at 'generation', as if not written out in full, and the translation follows the letter. 'Take a share' is drawing off a portion.

units.chapter_en: Seeking a school post (with the tuition fee)
units.title: 求馆·父为书馆，岂可逢空（旧注：占馆不以父母为师、当作书馆论；旺相有好馆，无父或落空必无书馆；占其年有无全要此爻出现有气；应来生合世自有人请，世生合应及父须自去访求；无父而动爻化出有人推荐，父化父有两处书馆，本宫化他宫由近及远）

rule.yi: 占馆不把父母当作老师，要当作书馆来看。父母旺相有气，就有好书馆；卦里没有父母或者落空，必定没有书馆，事情也难成。占那一年有没有书馆，全要这一爻出现、有气不空；应爻来生合世爻，自然有人来聘请，世爻生合应爻和父爻，就必须自己去访求；卦里没有父母而动爻化出父母的，意想不到有人推荐；父化父必有两处书馆；本宫化入他宫由近及远，他宫化入本宫从外到内。
rule.en: In divining a school post, Resource is not taken as the teacher but as the school itself. If Resource is thriving and has breath, there is a good school; if there is no Resource in the hexagram or it falls Void, there will surely be no school and the matter is hard to bring about. To divine whether there will be a school that year everything depends on this line appearing with breath and not Void; if the Other comes to generate or combine with the Self, someone naturally comes to engage one, and if the Self generates or combines with the Other and with Resource, one must go and seek on one's own; if there is no Resource in the hexagram but a moving line turns into it, someone unexpectedly recommends one; Resource turning into Resource means two schools; from the home palace into another palace is from near to far, and from another palace into the home palace is from outside to inside.

zh: 父为书馆，岂可逢空。
yi: 父母爻是书馆，怎么可以遇到空亡。
en: Resource is the school, and how can it meet Void.

zh: 占馆，不可以父母为师，当作书馆论之。
旺相有气，则有好书馆。
卦无父或落空，必无书馆，事亦难成。
若占其年书馆有无，全要此爻出现，有气不空，必然有得。
更得应来生合世爻，自有人来延请；
世爻生合应爻，及父爻，必须自去访求，无人相请。
卦无父，而动爻有化出者，不意中有人推荐也。
若父化父，必有两处书馆，卦有两爻亦然。
馆有定期，而遇父化父，馆必两处。
本宫化入他宫，由近及远；
他宫化入本宫，自外以入内也。
yi: 占馆，不能把父母当作老师，要当作书馆来看。
旺相有气，就有好的书馆。
卦里没有父母或者落空，必定没有书馆，事情也难成。
如果占那一年有没有书馆，全靠这一爻出现、有气不空，必定有馆。
再得到应爻来生合世爻，自然有人来聘请；
世爻生合应爻和父爻，就必须自己去访求，没有人来请。
卦里没有父母，而动爻有化出的，是意想不到有人推荐。
如果父化父，必有两处书馆，卦里有两个父爻也是这样。
馆有定期，而遇到父化父，馆必定是两处。
从本宫变到他宫，是由近处到远处；
他宫化入本宫，从外到内。
en: In divining a school post, Resource is not to be taken as the teacher but as the school itself.
If thriving and with breath, there is a good school.
If there is no Resource in the hexagram or it falls Void, there will surely be no school, and the matter is hard to bring about.
If one divines whether there will be a school that year, everything depends on this line appearing with breath and not Void, and then there will surely be one.
If the Other also comes to generate or combine with the Self, someone naturally comes to engage one;
if the Self generates or combines with the Other and with Resource, one must go and seek on one's own, and no one will come to engage one.
If there is no Resource in the hexagram but a moving line turns into it, someone unexpectedly recommends one.
If Resource turns into Resource, there will surely be two schools, and likewise if there are two Resource lines in the hexagram.
When the school has a fixed term and Resource turns into Resource, the schools are surely two.
From the home palace into another palace, from near to far;
from another palace into the home palace, from outside to inside.

zh: 占馆以父母爻为馆，旺相则有好馆。
卦无父或落空，必无书馆，事亦难成。
yi: 占馆以父母爻为书馆，旺相就有好馆。
卦里没有父母或者落空，必定没有书馆，事情也难成。
en: In divining a school post Resource is the school, and if thriving there is a good school.
If there is no Resource in the hexagram or it falls Void, there will surely be no school, and the matter is hard to bring about.

note.yi: 在这一章里「父母」不是老师（老师是世爻），而是「书馆」本身（馆舍、学馆）。这和占考试、占文书时父母是文书、功名的用法不同。「由近及远」「由外入内」是用本宫、他宫来看书馆的方位：变出在本宫是近处，变到他宫是远处。旧注比王洪绪多讲了：占那一年有没有书馆要看这一爻出现、有人聘请和自己去访求的区别、父化父有两馆。
note.en: In this chapter 'Resource' is not the teacher (the teacher is the Self) but the 'school' itself (the school building, the schoolhouse). This differs from the usage in examinations and documents, where Resource is documents and the degree. 'From near to far' and 'from outside to inside' use the home palace and other palaces to see where the school is: changing within the home palace is near, and changing into another palace is far. The old commentary says more than Wang Hongxu: to divine whether there will be a school that year one looks for this line to appear; the difference between being engaged and going to seek oneself; and Resource turning into Resource meaning two schools.

units.chapter_en: Seeking a school post (with the tuition fee)
units.title: 求馆·鬼动合身，须得贵人推荐（旧注：官鬼发动当有间阻；来生合世身则其馆必得贵人推荐而后可成；应如克世、父或落空虽荐不成）

rule.yi: 官鬼发动，应当有阻隔；但如果它来生合世爻、身爻，又主这个馆必得贵人推荐才能成；应爻如果克世，或者父母落空，即使有人推荐也不成。
rule.en: If Pressure moves there will be obstruction; but if it comes to generate or combine with the Self or the Body, it also means the school can be had only with a noble's recommendation; if the Other controls the Self, or Resource is Void, then even with a recommendation it does not come through.

zh: 鬼动合身，须得贵人推荐；
yi: 官鬼发动而合到世身上，须得有贵人推荐；
en: If Pressure moves and combines with the Self and the Body, a noble's recommendation is needed;

zh: 官鬼发动，当有间阻。
然来生合世身，又主其馆必得贵人推荐，而后可成；
应如克世，父或落空，虽荐不成。
yi: 官鬼发动，应当有阻隔。
但如果它来生合世爻、身爻，又主这个馆必得贵人推荐，然后才能成；
应爻如果克世，父母或者落空，即使有人推荐也不成。
en: If Pressure moves, there will be obstruction.
But if it comes to generate or combine with the Self or the Body, it also means the school will be had only with a noble's recommendation, and then it can come through;
if the Other controls the Self, or Resource is Void, then even with a recommendation it does not come through.

zh: 官鬼发动当有间阻，若来生合世身，必得贵人推荐可成。
yi: 官鬼发动应当有阻隔，如果来生合世爻、身爻，必得到贵人推荐才能成。
en: If Pressure moves there should be obstruction, and if it comes to generate or combine with the Self or the Body, one must have a noble's recommendation for it to come through.

note.yi: 这一联的「官鬼」同时有两面：发动就有阻隔（鬼是阻碍），但生合世身时又是「贵人」（鬼是官，官是推荐人）。书里没有说怎么分清它是阻碍还是贵人，只说要看它和世身的关系：生合是推荐，克世是阻。这和 LY.CAREER.HJC.06（官爻临持身世是称意）是同一个道理。
note.en: In this couplet Pressure has two faces at once: moving, it obstructs (Pressure is the obstacle), but generating or combining with the Self and the Body it is the 'noble' (Pressure is an official, and an official is the one who recommends). The book does not say how to tell whether it is an obstacle or a noble, only that one looks at its relation to the Self and the Body: generating or combining is recommendation, and controlling the Self is obstruction. This is the same principle as LY.CAREER.HJC.06 (Pressure resting on the Self or the Body is to one's liking).

units.chapter_en: Seeking a school post (with the tuition fee)
units.title: 求馆·兄兴临应，决多同类侵谋（旧注：应持兄动必有同道争谋其馆，兄临卦身亦然；间爻动冲克世则有人破说其事难成）

rule.yi: 占学馆，应爻持兄弟发动，必有同行的人来争谋这个馆，兄弟临卦身也是这样；如果在间爻上发动、冲克世爻，就主有人从中说坏话，事情难成。
rule.en: In divining a school post, if the Other holds Peer and it moves, there will surely be fellow teachers contending for the post, and likewise if Peer rests on the Body; if it moves on a between line and clashes or controls the Self, it means someone undermines it by talk, and the matter is hard to bring about.

zh: 兄兴临应，决多同类侵谋。
yi: 兄弟兴旺临在应上，必定多有同类的人来侵夺谋取。
en: When Peer flourishes and rests on the Other, there will surely be many of the same kind coming to encroach and scheme for it.

zh: 凡占学馆，应持兄动，必有同道之人争谋其馆；
兄临卦身亦然。
若在间爻动，冲克世，则主有破说，其事难成。
yi: 凡是占学馆，应爻持兄弟发动，必有同行的人争谋这个馆；
兄弟临卦身也是这样。
如果在间爻上发动、冲克世爻，就主有人从中说坏话，事情难成。
en: In divining a school, if the Other holds Peer and it moves, there will surely be fellow teachers contending for this post;
likewise if Peer rests on the Body.
If it moves on a between line and clashes or controls the Self, it means someone undermines it by talk, and the matter is hard to bring about.

zh: 凡应持兄动，必有同道之人争谋其馆，兄临卦身亦然；
若在间爻动来冲克世爻，主有人破说也。
yi: 凡是应持兄弟发动，必有同行的人争谋这个馆，兄弟临卦身也是这样；
如果在间爻上发动来冲克世爻，主有人说破。
en: Whenever the Other holds Peer and it moves, there will surely be fellow teachers contending for the post, and likewise if Peer rests on the Body;
if it moves on a between line and comes to clash or control the Self, someone breaks it up by talk.

note.yi: 「同道之人」是同行，也就是同样想谋这个馆的先生。兄弟在占财时是劫财的竞争者，在占馆时是同行的竞争者，是同一个象。「破说」是从中说坏话、把事说破。「间爻」是世应之间的爻。
note.en: 'Fellow teachers' are people of the same trade, that is, other teachers who also wish for this post. Peer is the rival that robs wealth in divining wealth and the rival of the same trade in divining a school post, the same image. 'Undermines it by talk' is speaking ill from the side and breaking the matter up. 'A between line' is a line between the Self and the Other.

units.chapter_en: Seeking a school post (with the tuition fee)
units.title: 求馆·官如藏伏，应无督集之人（旧注：官鬼能生父母，占馆以此爻为纠率子弟之人；不出现或落空必无人聚生徒成学馆又无人推荐；空而逢冲、伏而提起须央浼其人方肯出来）

rule.yi: 官鬼能生扶父母，所以占馆以官鬼这一爻代表招集率领学生的人。官鬼不出现或者落空，必定没有人聚集学生来成学馆，事情难成，也没有人推荐；如果空而逢冲、伏而被提起，必须央求那个人，他才肯出来招集。
rule.en: Pressure can generate and support Resource, so in divining a school post the Pressure line stands for the person who gathers and leads the pupils. If Pressure does not appear or falls Void, there will surely be no one to gather pupils to make up a school, the matter is hard to bring about, and no one will recommend one; if it is Void and meets a clash, or is hidden and drawn up, one must beg that person before he is willing to come forward and gather them.

zh: 官如藏伏，应无督集之人；
yi: 官鬼如果隐伏，应当没有招集学生的人；
en: If Pressure lies hidden, there will be no one to gather the pupils;

zh: 鬼能生扶父母，故占馆以此爻为纠率子弟之人。
若不出现，或落空，必主无人聚集生徒，以成学馆。
其事难成，又主无人推荐。
若空而逢冲，伏而提起，必须央浼其人，方许出来纠集。
yi: 官鬼能生扶父母，所以占馆以这一爻作为纠合率领子弟的人。
如果它不出现，或者落空，必主没有人聚集学生来成学馆。
这事难成，又主没有人推荐。
如果空而逢冲，伏而被提起，必须央求那个人，才肯出来招集。
en: Pressure can generate and support Resource, so in divining a school post this line is the person who gathers and leads the pupils.
If it does not appear or falls Void, there will surely be no one to gather pupils to make up a school.
The matter is hard to bring about, and no one will recommend one.
If it is Void and meets a clash, or hidden and drawn up, one must beg that person before he is willing to come forward and gather them.

zh: 鬼能生扶父母，故占馆以此爻为纠率子弟之人。
皆不出现，或出现旬空，主无人聚生徒以成学馆也。
yi: 官鬼能生扶父母，所以占馆以这一爻作为纠合率领子弟的人。
如果都不出现，或者出现而旬空，主没有人聚集学生来成学馆。
en: Pressure can generate and support Resource, so in divining a school post this line is the person who gathers and leads the pupils.
If neither appears, or one appears but is Void in the ten-day cycle, there will be no one to gather pupils to make up a school.

note.yi: 这一章里的官鬼有两个用处：发动合身是「贵人推荐」（LY.CAREER.HJC.36），不动而在卦是「招集学生的人」（这一条）。「纠率子弟」是召集并带领学生。「央浼」是恳求。
note.en: In this chapter Pressure has two uses: moving and combining with the Body is 'a noble's recommendation' (LY.CAREER.HJC.36), and present in the hexagram and not moving it is 'the person who gathers the pupils' (this entry). 'Gather and lead' is calling the pupils together and leading them. 'Beg' is entreating.

units.chapter_en: Seeking a school post (with the tuition fee)
units.title: 求馆·应若空亡，未有招延之主（旧注：应空无人延请，父不出现或落空必难成；应动空化空是假言作主；父临身或动来生合世身大吉馆易成；应空鬼动宜自开馆、鬼空伏应生合宜自招致）

rule.yi: 应爻空亡，没有人来聘请；再如果父母不出现或者落空，必定难成；应爻动空、化空，是说空话、假装作主，不然也不能把事做完。父母临身，或者动爻来生合世身，是大吉的兆头，这个馆容易成；有这种象而应空、官鬼动，虽然有招集学生的人，却没有聘请的主人，适合自己开馆；官鬼空伏而应来生合，虽然有聘请的人家，却没有招集学生的人，适合自己去招来学生。
rule.en: If the Other is Void, no one comes to engage one; if Resource also does not appear or falls Void, the matter will surely be hard to bring about; if the Other moves into Void or turns into Void, he only says it in words and pretends to be the master, and otherwise the matter is not seen through to the end. If Resource rests on the Body, or a moving line comes to generate or combine with the Self or the Body, it is a greatly auspicious sign and the school comes easily; with this image but the Other Void and Pressure moving, though there is someone to gather pupils there is no master to engage one, and it is fitting to open a school oneself; if Pressure is Void and hidden while the Other comes to generate or combine, though there is a household that would engage one there is no one to gather pupils, and it is fitting to draw in pupils oneself.

zh: 应若空亡，未有招延之主。
yi: 应爻如果空亡，就没有聘请的主人。
en: If the Other is Void, there is no master to engage one.

zh: 应爻空亡，无人延请。
更若父不出现，或落空，必难成就。
应爻动空化空，是假言作主也。
不然，亦主不终其事。
凡遇父母临身，或遇动来生合世身，大吉之兆，主其馆易成。
有此象而应空鬼动，虽有纠集之人，而无招延之主，宜自开馆。
若鬼爻空伏，而应来生合，虽有延请之家，而无纠集之人，宜有招致。
yi: 应爻空亡，没有人来聘请。
再如果父母不出现，或者落空，必定难成。
应爻动空、化空，是说空话、假装作主。
不然，也主不能把事做完。
凡是遇到父母临身，或者遇到动爻来生合世爻、身爻，是大吉的兆头，主这个馆容易成。
有这种象而应爻空、官鬼动，虽然有招集学生的人，却没有聘请的主人，适合自己开馆。
如果官鬼空伏，而应爻来生合，虽然有聘请的人家，却没有招集学生的人，适合自己去招来学生。
en: If the Other is Void, no one comes to engage one.
If Resource also does not appear or falls Void, the matter will surely be hard to bring about.
If the Other moves into Void or turns into Void, he only says it in words and pretends to be the master.
Otherwise the matter will not be seen through to the end.
If Resource rests on the Body, or a moving line comes to generate or combine with the Self or the Body, it is a greatly auspicious sign and the school comes easily.
If one has this image but the Other is Void and Pressure moves, though there is someone to gather pupils there is no master to engage one, and it is fitting to open a school oneself.

If Pressure is Void and hidden while the Other comes to generate or combine, though there is a household that would engage one there is no one to gather pupils, and it is fitting to draw in pupils oneself.

zh: 应爻空亡无人延请，更若父不出现或落空，必难成就；
应爻动空化空，是假言作主也。
yi: 应爻空亡没有人聘请，再如果父母不出现或者落空，必定难成；
应爻动空、化空，是说空话、假装作主。
en: If the Other is Void no one engages one, and if Resource also does not appear or falls Void, the matter will surely be hard to bring about;
if the Other moves into Void or turns into Void, he only says it in words and pretends to be the master.

note.yi: 这一联把「应」（聘请的人）、「官鬼」（招集学生的人）、「父母」（书馆）三样放在一起：缺哪样，就要自己补哪样（没有人聘请就自己开馆，没有人招集学生就自己招）。「招延」是招聘、聘请，「延请」同义。旧注后面两段（「父母临身……」「有此象而应空鬼动……」）王洪绪没有写。
note.en: This couplet puts three things together: the Other (the one who engages), Pressure (the one who gathers pupils) and Resource (the school), and what is missing one must make up oneself (open a school oneself if no one engages one, draw in pupils oneself if no one gathers them). 'Engage' and 'invite' are synonyms. The last two paragraphs of the old commentary ('Resource rests on the Body ...' and 'with this image but the Other Void and Pressure moving ...') are not in Wang Hongxu.
